explanation: The opening of 1969 was real enough to be tested and narrow enough to fail the test. The regime let the opposition campaign and then beat it with a system that made its votes worthless. The censorship returned within months. The liberal deputies elected inside the National Union found they could not legislate and were gone by 1973. That closed the civilian road out of the regime. The officers who acted in April 1974 needed no theory that the Estado Novo could not reform itself with voters in the room. They had watched it try and stop.
